grounding.reason: R-0003 flags: any group with 1 sample forbids inferential DE testing (dispersion cannot be estimated); outcome is descriptive_only — report normalized counts and descriptive log2FC, no p-values, and state the design limitation.

Applies Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction to enrichment results and collapses redundant significant gene sets

plan.title: Liver treated vs control: descriptive DE (no replicates)
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset has exactly one treated and one control liver sample (12000 genes x 3 columns implies gene column + 2 samples), raw salmon-derived integer counts, no biological replication. The knowledge service flags this design explicitly: with n=1 per group, no within-group variance/dispersion can be estimated, so no inferential DE test (DESeq2 Wald/LRT, edgeR, limma-voom) has a valid statistical basis. The plan therefore proceeds descriptively: normalize with DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors (computable without replicates), report per-gene normalized counts and raw (unshrunk) log2 fold changes ranked by magnitude, run sample-structure QC appropriate to n=1/group (library size, count distributions - no PCA/vst possible meaningfully with 2 samples), and follow with a hypothesis-generating pathway enrichment (fgsea preranked on the descriptive log2FC) against Hallmark gene sets, explicitly labeled as exploratory since it rests on an underpowered comparison. The final report states the design limitation, the descriptive nature of every 'DE' gene list produced, and what design (biological replicates) would be needed to support statistical inference.
